title: Pool the street's order
brief: Our street pools bulk grocery orders in a group chat, and every round someone's quantity is lost before pickup day.

target_population.role: block captain pooling pantry staples for eleven fictional households
target_population.coverage_limit: one street's order rounds; quantities and pickup slots only, no money handling

core_task.summary: join an open bulk order with a quantity and receive a pickup window
core_task.success_oracle: joining the rice order with 5 kg updates its pooled meter to 40 of 50 kg and assigns the joining household a pickup window

not_applicable_states.loading: open orders and joins are seeded local records, so the pooled meter and pickup roster update in the same frame as the join

state_recipes.empty: close both seeded orders at their caps; the street page shows its no-open-rounds message with the next-round hint
state_recipes.validation-error: join the rice order with 20 kg when only 15 remain; the error shows the remaining capacity and refuses
state_recipes.success: join the rice order with 5 kg as Household 9; the meter reads 40 of 50 kg and a pickup window appears
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the rice order's quantity field shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the page at 390x844; order meter cards stack with join forms inline

acceptance_facts: The seed has two open orders: 50 kg of rice pooled at 35 kg and 24 jars of honey pooled at 18.
Joining the rice order with 5 kg moves its pool to 40 of 50 kg and assigns a pickup window.
A join that would push a pool past its cap is refused with the remaining amount shown.

product_signature.mechanism: pooled-progress meters that close each order exactly at its bulk cap
product_signature.anchor: order meter cards on the street page
product_signature.brief_trace: someone's quantity is lost before pickup day
product_signature.counterfactual: a group-chat transcript would fit a messaging brief and loses quantities in the scroll
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the rice meter at 40 of 50 kg with Household 9's pickup window issued

anti_goals: no payments, price splitting, or money collection
no supplier ordering or inventory; rounds are neighbor coordination only

content_seed.data_notes: eleven invented households on one invented street; rice starts at 35 of 50 kg so the 5 kg join lands exactly on 40
